title: Top Judge
plot_source_plaintext: Harry becomes uncharacteristically glum and morose when an elderly judge dies after one of Harry's pranks. His friends urge him to respond when a new judge (Gary Kroeger) lays claim to Harry's crown as the "King of the Courtroom Cutups."
